github.description: One sentence in, an expert deck out. This DSH plugin adds a slide-expert persona, a LibreOffice Impress MCP server (7 tools + table reading + 18 matplotlib chart types) and a live browser preview that follows the agent page by page. Layout audits, animations, pptx/odp delivery, multi-round memory. Clone + setup.sh; needs LibreOffice (MPL-2.0).
